name: Wheeled Humanoid Robot
summary:
Cyborg-W01 is the wheeled humanoid member of Cyborg Robotics' platform range. It combines mobile positioning with an upper-body robot configuration for developing physical tasks and inspection workflows. The wheeled design provides an alternative to the company's bipedal platform for suitable operating surfaces.

The manufacturer focuses on industrial sectors including energy, chemicals, mining and heavy manufacturing, where robots can be configured with perception and inspection equipment for particular jobs. It also identifies research, education and data collection as uses for its systems.

It also identifies research, education and data collection as uses for its systems. Model-specific tooling, payload and autonomy should be established for the delivered W01 configuration.
description.zh: 面向工业巡检、自主分拣和物料搬运的轮式人形机器人，融合移动底盘、高负载机械臂和多模态感知。
